The '''Kwenn Space Station''', sometimes called '''Space Station Kwenn''', was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] located in the [[Kastolar sector/Legends|Kastolar sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Coreward]] edge of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. It was situated along the [[Ootmian Pabol/Legends|''Ootmian Pabol'']] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]].

The Kwenn Space Station [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kwenn/Legends|Kwenn]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Kwenn_system.png|thumb|left|200px|Kwenn Space Station orbiting Kwenn]]
The Kwenn Space Station had a three-tiered structure. At the top was a city-like structure, which was home to entertainment and recreational facilities for travelers. Below that was a platform with dozens of space docks for smaller ships. These space docks had a modular construction, and could easily be reconfigured for starships of various classes and sizes. At the bottom was a hexagonal latticework structure, which acted as a [[Drydock/Legends|drydock]] for large [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] (such as [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]]). [[Repulsorlift/Legends|Repulsorlift]] tubes and corridors led from the main drydock and the smaller docking bays into the main part of the station.

==History==
The station was eons old.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

As the [[Kwenn system/Legends|Kwenn system]] was on the outer edge of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] near a major [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]], the station acted as the last major supply depot and refueling station for [[Starship/Legends|starships]] heading for the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

In the wake of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] arsenal ship, which had been transporting several [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|battle droids]] for destruction at a Republic decommissioning facility, had gone missing. The [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Office of the Supreme Chancellor]] and the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] sent a team consisting of [[Vor'en Kurn]], [[Sia-Lan Wezz]], [[Rorworr (Naboo)|Rorworr]], and [[Deel Surool]] to locate the vessel. The team's search led them to Kwenn Space Station, where they became involved in a firefight when they discovered several reactivated battle droids in the station's lower levels.<ref name="Core Rulebook">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref>

The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] had minimal presence on the station; some of its [[hangar/Legends|docking bays]] and repair docks served Imperial ships.<ref name="TEA" />

In the early days of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], a [[Ylesia/Legends#Rebellion Era|financial debacle on Ylesia]] led to the Hutt clan [[Besadii/Legends|Besadii]] selling Kwenn Space Station to [[Kwenn Holdings]]. After the sale, other criminal elements, such as the [[Anjiliac]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]], [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], and the [[Tenloss Syndicate/Legends|Tenloss Syndicate]] vied for control of the space station. At this time, the Kwenn Space Station was considered neutral territory between the Hutts and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="Lords of Nal Hutta">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref> 

Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Relentless (Dorja)|''Relentless'']] docked at Kwenn Space Station. The hunt for [[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]] began there.<ref name="TM">''[[Tatooine Manhunt]]''</ref>

Rebel agent [[Kassar Kosciusko]] tried to keep a cell on Kwenn. Unfortunately, the activities of [[Ketton/Legends|Ketton]] spy [[Derrida/Legends|Derrida]] often disrupted Kosciusko's activities.<ref name="air">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref> Eventually, Derrida was apprehended by [[Kyle Katarn]] and a [[Max (bunny)|pint-sized lagomorph]], who almost razed Kwenn station capturing her.<ref name="DFS1">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050407a|series=The Dark Forces Saga|text=Part 1}}</ref>

[[Sard Nightbringer]] held an auction to sell an experimental personal shield generator that she looted from [[Imperial Research and Development Station T-1583]] on the ''[[Stellar Mermaid]]'' which was docked at the station .<ref name="ArtofBetrayal">{{WEGCite|story=The Art of Betrayal|book=The Politics of Contraband}}</ref>
